content: How many examinations do you have, Tom?
Three, two this week, and one next Monday. How about you?
Two, both are in this week. Then I have to write two papers. I'd rather have examinations.
Well, you only recite a lot for examinations. You can work really hard for a couple of days, then that's all.
Yeah, I know. But I like papers better than examinations. Urn, where did I put my I.C. card?
I don't know. Oh, God! I don't know what's wrong with me.
